# ScreenHarmony Flex v2.9.2-alpha 🧪⚡

> *"Bleeding-edge goodness for brave testers who like their apps fast, their schedules punctual, and their bugs extinct."* 🦕💥

---

### 🧪 What's Cooking in This Alpha Drop:

- 🧙‍♂️ **Multi-Step Parent Auth**: 3-step registration wizard (Account info -> Instant Availability -> 12-Word Recovery phrase).
- 📋 **Phrase Security Tooling**: Added instant Copy Phrase and Download / Share text file buttons for BIP39 mnemonic keys.
- 🛑 **Infinite Loader Extermination**: Slapped 3.5s/6s timeouts on all availability checks with offline fallback support. No more spinning limbo.
- 📱 **Responsive UI Overhaul**: Fixed cramped dialog views with full scroll containers and soft-keyboard adaptability.
- 🪟 **Compact Top-Dock Update Banner**: Sleek status pill and in-app APK installer on Blocks & Parenting screens.
- 🛡️ **Multi-OEM Anti-Tamper & Exact Alarms**: Armor against aggressive background killers.

---
*Happy testing! Report anything weird and stay locked in.* 🚀
